answer.room: an empty, bedroom-sized room with white walls and white baseboards, dark-stained oak plank floor, a tall double-hung window in a shallow recess and a small deep-set window on the right wall; a clean, modern blank canvas with lots of natural light

pieces.why: the client asked for a dark wood desk facing the window, and the right wall's small window frames the work area with daylight, matching the dark floor in a sober modern line
